# Stalwart

> Stalwart is an open-source mail and collaboration server written in Rust. A single binary implements JMAP, IMAP4, POP3, SMTP, CalDAV, CardDAV, and WebDAV, covering email, calendaring, contacts, and file storage. It is designed to run from a single-node personal deployment up to a clustered multi-node installation.

This file indexes the official Stalwart documentation at https://stalw.art/docs. The documentation is the source of truth for configuration keys, protocol support, deployment topologies, and administration. The server source code lives in a separate repository at https://github.com/stalwartlabs.

The documentation is versioned; links below point at the current release line. Older releases, when archived, are available under `/docs/<version>/…`.

## Installation

- [Getting started](https://stalw.art/docs/install/): the path from a new host to a server that sends and receives mail.
- [System requirements](https://stalw.art/docs/install/requirements): platforms, network prerequisites, memory, CPU and outbound connections.
- [Install on Linux, macOS and FreeBSD](https://stalw.art/docs/install/platform/linux): step-by-step tutorial with the installation script, from host names to a test message.
- [Install on Docker](https://stalw.art/docs/install/platform/docker): step-by-step tutorial with the container image, from host names to a test message.
- [Install on Windows](https://stalw.art/docs/install/platform/windows): step-by-step tutorial with an NSSM service, from host names to a test message.
- [Securing the server](https://stalw.art/docs/install/security): steps to take before production use.
- [Next steps](https://stalw.art/docs/install/next-steps): domains, accounts, clients, backups and the options a first installation leaves at their defaults.
- [Setup wizard](https://stalw.art/docs/install/setup-wizard): reference for every field and error of the setup wizard.
- [Choose a storage backend](https://stalw.art/docs/install/store): the four stores and how to choose their backends.
- [Choose a directory](https://stalw.art/docs/install/directory): internal vs. external authentication directories.
- [DNS records](https://stalw.art/docs/install/dns): records required for SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, autoconfig and more.
- [Troubleshooting installation](https://stalw.art/docs/install/troubleshooting): installation problems by symptom.
- [Setting up clients](https://stalw.art/docs/server/clients): client settings, DAV and JMAP URLs, and automatic discovery.
- [Upgrading](https://stalw.art/docs/install/upgrade): upgrading between Stalwart 1.x releases.

## Email and collaboration

- [Email store overview](https://stalw.art/docs/email/): JMAP/IMAP/POP3 mail storage model.
- [Collaboration overview](https://stalw.art/docs/collaboration/): calendars, contacts, file storage, sharing.
- [Calendaring (CalDAV)](https://stalw.art/docs/collaboration/calendar): calendar scheduling and CalDAV support.
- [Contacts (CardDAV)](https://stalw.art/docs/collaboration/contact): address book and CardDAV support.
- [File storage (WebDAV)](https://stalw.art/docs/collaboration/file-storage): file storage and WebDAV.
- [Sharing](https://stalw.art/docs/collaboration/sharing): access control across calendars, address books and files.
- [Scheduling](https://stalw.art/docs/collaboration/scheduling): iTIP/iMIP calendar scheduling.
- [Notifications](https://stalw.art/docs/collaboration/notifications): push and email notifications.
- [Free/busy and availability](https://stalw.art/docs/collaboration/availability): free/busy queries over JMAP and CalDAV.

## MTA (SMTP)

- [MTA overview](https://stalw.art/docs/mta/): inbound and outbound SMTP pipeline.
- [Inbound overview](https://stalw.art/docs/mta/inbound/): inbound session handling (connect, EHLO, MAIL, RCPT, DATA, AUTH).
- [Outbound strategies](https://stalw.art/docs/mta/outbound/strategy): queue, routing, retry, quotas and rate limits.
- [Filtering overview](https://stalw.art/docs/mta/filter/): Sieve, milter, MTA-hooks, and spam filtering.
- [Sender authentication](https://stalw.art/docs/mta/authentication/): SPF, DKIM, DKIM2, DMARC, ARC and reverse DNS checks.
- [DKIM](https://stalw.art/docs/mta/authentication/dkim/) and [DKIM2](https://stalw.art/docs/mta/authentication/dkim/dkim2): signing and verification.
- [Reports](https://stalw.art/docs/mta/reports/): DMARC, TLS, and DSN reporting.
- [Transport security](https://stalw.art/docs/mta/transport-security/): DANE, MTA-STS, and TLS reporting.
- [Queue management](https://stalw.art/docs/mta/management): operating the outbound queue.

## Spam filter

- [Spam filter overview](https://stalw.art/docs/spamfilter/): architecture of the built-in filter.
- [Classifier overview](https://stalw.art/docs/spamfilter/classifier/): the linear spam classifier.
- [AI classifier](https://stalw.art/docs/spamfilter/ai/): classifying spam and phishing with an AI model.
- [Authentication tags](https://stalw.art/docs/spamfilter/settings/scores#authentication-tags), [DNSBL](https://stalw.art/docs/spamfilter/dnsbl), [Greylisting](https://stalw.art/docs/spamfilter/greylist), [Phishing](https://stalw.art/docs/spamfilter/phishing): individual checks.
- [Rules](https://stalw.art/docs/spamfilter/rules): custom rule definitions.
- [Domain lists](https://stalw.art/docs/spamfilter/settings/domain-lists) and [File extensions](https://stalw.art/docs/spamfilter/settings/mime-types): the lookup lists and attachment classifications the filter consults.
- [Trusted senders](https://stalw.art/docs/spamfilter/trusted) and [Spam traps](https://stalw.art/docs/spamfilter/spamtrap).

- [User scripts](https://stalw.art/docs/sieve/user-scripts): uploading and managing scripts over ManageSieve and JMAP.
- [Sieve interpreters](https://stalw.art/docs/sieve/#two-interpreters): trusted and untrusted interpreters.
- [Reference](https://stalw.art/docs/sieve/reference): supported commands and tests.

- [Examples](https://stalw.art/docs/sieve/examples).

- [JMAP overview](https://stalw.art/docs/http/jmap/): JMAP Core and Mail endpoints, push, WebSockets.
- [JMAP capabilities](https://stalw.art/docs/http/jmap/capabilities): advertised capabilities and their limits.
- [WebDAV overview](https://stalw.art/docs/http/webdav/): CalDAV, CardDAV, and WebDAV endpoints.
- [Access control](https://stalw.art/docs/http/access-control): HTTP access control lists.
- [HTTP server](https://stalw.art/docs/http/settings): response headers, forwarded IPs, HSTS, CORS and request rate limits.
- [Form submission](https://stalw.art/docs/http/form-submission): contact-form / webhook email submission.

## Authentication and authorization

- [Auth overview](https://stalw.art/docs/auth/): identity model.
- [Authentication overview](https://stalw.art/docs/auth/authentication/): passwords, app passwords, API keys, 2FA.
- [OAuth and OpenID Connect](https://stalw.art/docs/auth/oauth/): the built-in authorization server: clients, scopes, consent, tokens and OpenID Connect.
- [Authorization overview](https://stalw.art/docs/auth/authorization/): roles, permissions, quotas, tenants.
- [Directory backends](https://stalw.art/docs/auth/backend/): SQL, LDAP, OIDC and internal directory.
- [Accounts](https://stalw.art/docs/auth/accounts/): user and group accounts.
- [SCIM provisioning](https://stalw.art/docs/auth/scim/): SCIM 2.0 account lifecycle from an external identity provider.

## Storage

- [Storage overview](https://stalw.art/docs/storage/): data, blob, search and in-memory stores, and lookup lists.
- [Data store](https://stalw.art/docs/storage/data): metadata and indexes.
- [Blob store](https://stalw.art/docs/storage/blob): raw message and file blobs.
- [Full-text search](https://stalw.art/docs/storage/fts): FTS backends.
- [Search indexing](https://stalw.art/docs/storage/indexing): the index queue and rebuilding the index.
- [Attachment text extraction](https://stalw.art/docs/storage/text-extraction): document formats indexed for search.
- [In-memory store](https://stalw.art/docs/storage/in-memory): rate-limit counters, greylisting entries, locks and short-lived tokens; Redis for clusters.
- [Cache swapping](https://stalw.art/docs/storage/cache-swap): persisted account cache snapshots.
- [Data retention](https://stalw.art/docs/storage/maintenance): purging deleted and expired data and reclaiming disk space.
- [Backends overview](https://stalw.art/docs/storage/backends/): RocksDB, FoundationDB, SQL, S3, and others.

- [Auto-ban](https://stalw.art/docs/server/auto-ban): automatic IP banning.
- [Reverse proxy](https://stalw.art/docs/server/reverse-proxy/): running behind nginx, HAProxy, Caddy, or Traefik.
- [ASN](https://stalw.art/docs/server/asn): ASN-based controls.
- [Object metadata](https://stalw.art/docs/server/metadata): IMAP METADATA, JMAP metadata and WebDAV dead properties.
- [Enterprise features](https://stalw.art/docs/server/enterprise): features in the commercial edition.

## Migration

- [Migration overview](https://stalw.art/docs/migration/): moving a populated mail system onto Stalwart with the migration proxy and Vandelay.
- [Migration guide](https://stalw.art/docs/migration/guide/): side-by-side, account-by-account migration from a self-hosted server.
- [Migrating from hosted services](https://stalw.art/docs/migration/guide/hosted): Google Workspace and Microsoft 365.
- [Migration proxy](https://stalw.art/docs/migration/proxy/): routing connections between the old and new servers.
- [Vandelay](https://stalw.art/docs/migration/import-export/): import and export of mailboxes, calendars and contacts.
